name: Jibble
description:
Jibble is the highest-rated time tracking and attendance software according to independent user reviews. With free forever time tracking for unlimited users, teams can track hours, attendance, projects, time off, and more.

Connect Jibble to Claude and turn your workforce data into instant answers, insights, and actions. Ask Claude how many hours your team worked, where time is being spent, who’s working overtime, how attendance is trending, or how many hours have been logged to a project. Claude can analyze your Jibble data, summarize findings, compare results, and surface useful patterns without having to dig through reports.

You can also take action directly from the conversation—clock in or out, correct missed punches, manage time off, and generate reports.

Whether you’re checking a single person’s hours or looking for broader workforce trends, Jibble + Claude gives you a faster way to ask questions, understand your data, and get things done.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jibble to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jibble to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jibble.io/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jibble MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jibble lists 73 MCP tools, including add_activities, add_clients, add_hour_entries, add_projects, add_schedule, assign_person_to_position, assign_schedules, clock_in, clock_out, delete_schedules, end_break, and get_all_activities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jibble?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jibble in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Jibble requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jibble is developed by Jibble. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
